description: This file implements a middleware component (TlsClientConnectionMiddleware) for handling TLS client connections within an Orleans-based server. It manages TLS handshake, certificate validation, and setting relevant connection features.

classes.name: TlsClientConnectionMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class responsible for establishing and managing TLS client connections, including certificate validation and feature setup.

methods.name: TlsClientConnectionMiddleware
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with connection delegate, TLS options, and logger factory.

methods.name: OnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Entry point to handle a new connection asynchronously, delegating to inner connection processing.

methods.name: InnerOnConnectionAsync
methods.description: Performs the TLS handshake, certificate validation, and feature configuration for the connection.

methods.name: ValidateCertificate
methods.description: Validates and potentially returns the local certificate based on the remote certificate mode.

methods.name: EnsureCertificateIsAllowedForClientAuth
methods.description: Verifies that a provided certificate is permitted for client authentication.

methods.name: ConvertToX509Certificate2
methods.description: Converts an X509Certificate object to X509Certificate2.
